claim.en: According to The Slovak Spectator (2014), Ivan Kuhn of the Conservative Institute wrote a study on Star EU's procurement wins, after which the National Criminal Agency's anti-corruption unit launched an investigation.
claim.sk: Podľa The Slovak Spectator (2014) Ivan Kuhn z Konzervatívneho inštitútu napísal štúdiu o úspechoch firmy Star EU vo verejných obstarávaniach, po ktorej protikorupčná jednotka NAKA začala vyšetrovanie.

findings.identity: Article names Ivan Kuhn as an analyst of the Conservative Institute and a municipal politician in Rožňava; the candidate is an analyst from Rožňava, 60.
findings.quote: The circumstances of Star EU have been described in a study written by Ivan Kuhn from the non-governmental think tank Conservative Institute of M. R. Štefánik. … the anti-corruption unit of the National Criminal Agency launched an investigation into the suspicious procurements that Kuhn highlighted in his study
findings.title: Study uncovers possible cronyism - The Slovak Spectator
